'''Judith Greenwald Voet''' (born March 10, 1941)<ref>{{Cite journal | url = https://books.google.com/books?id=Ej0gAAAAMAAJ&q=%22voet,+judith+greenwald%22 | title = American men and women of science: The physical and biological sciences | last1 = Press | first1 = Jaques Cattell | year = 1982}}</ref> is a James Hammons Professor, Emerita in the department of chemistry and biochemistry at [[Swarthmore College]].<ref name="PKAL">{{cite web|url=http://www.biologie.uni-hamburg.de/b-online/pkal/program/voet.html|title=Project Kaleidoscope: Judith G. Voet|date=8 May 2000|publisher=Project Kaleidoscope|accessdate=18 January 2010|archive-date=5 June 2011|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110605181231/http://www.biologie.uni-hamburg.de/b-online/pkal/program/voet.html|url-status=dead}}</ref> Her research interests include [[enzyme]] reaction mechanisms and enzyme [[Enzyme inhibitors|inhibition]]. She and her husband, [[Donald Voet]], are authors of biochemistry textbooks that are widely used in undergraduate and graduate curricula.<ref name="whatislife">{{cite web|url=http://www.whatislife.com/reviews/voet.htm|title=Reviews of books by Donald Voet, Judith Voet|last=Buehler |first=Lukas K. |date=January 2, 2000|publisher=Lukas K. Buehler |accessdate=18 January 2010}}</ref><ref name="TiBS">{{cite journal|doi=10.1016/S0968-0004(99)01447-4|last=Wood|first= E.J.|date=1 October 1999|title=Book review: Biochemistry in a nutshell - Fundamentals of Biochemistry by Donald Voet, Judith G. Voet and Charlotte W. Pratt|journal=Trends in Biochemical Sciences|volume=24|issue=10|pages= 409–410}}</ref>

==Education==
Voet earned her B.S. degree from [[Antioch College]] and her Ph.D. from [[Brandeis University]].<ref name="PDB">{{cite journal|date=Summer 2008|title=Biochemistry and Molecular Biology Education (BAMBED), a Journal for University, College, and High School Educators by Judith G. Voet1 and Donald H. Voet2, BAMBED Co-Editors-in-Chief|journal=Protein Databank Newsletter|publisher=RCSB PDB|issue=38|pages=5|url=http://ftp.wwpdb.org/pub/pdb/doc/newsletters/rcsb_pdb/news38_jul08.pdf|archive-date=2023-01-27|access-date=2021-10-11|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230127162132/https://ftp.wwpdb.org/pub/pdb/doc/newsletters/rcsb_pdb/news38_jul08.pdf|url-status=dead}}</ref>

==Career==
Voet participated in postdoctoral research at the [[University of Pennsylvania]], [[Haverford College]], and the [[Fox Chase Cancer Center]] before securing her faculty position at Swarthmore in 1979.<ref name="PKAL"/> Voet and her husband were coeditors-in-chief of the journal ''Biochemical and Molecular Biology Education''.<ref name="PDB" />

==Notable publications==
*Voet, D; Voet, J.G.; and Pratt, C.W., Fundamentals of Biochemistry, Life at the molecular level (4th ed.), John Wiley & Sons (2013)
* Voet, D; Voet, J.G.; and Pratt, C.W., ''Fundamentals of Biochemistry'' (3rd ed.), John Wiley & Sons (2008)
*Uzman, A.; Eichberg, J.; Widger, W.; Cornely, K.; Voet, D.; Voet, J.G.; and Pratt, C.W.; ''Student Companion to Accompany Fundamentals of Biochemistry'' (2nd ed.), John Wiley & Sons (2006)
*Voet, D; Voet, J.G.; and Pratt, C.W.; ''Fundamentals of Biochemistry'' (2nd ed.), John Wiley & Sons (2006)
*Voet, D. and Voet, J. G., ''Solutions Manual to Accompany Biochemistry'' (3rd ed.), John Wiley & Sons (2004)
*Voet, D. and Voet, J. G., ''Biochemistry'' (3rd ed.), John Wiley & Sons (2004)<ref name="TiBS" /><ref name="PennChem">{{cite web|url=http://www.chem.upenn.edu/chem/research/faculty.php?browse=V|title=Penn Chemistry: Faculty Donald Voet|year=2005|publisher=The Trustees of the University of Pennsylvania|accessdate=18 January 2010|archive-date=11 September 2007|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070911065858/http://www.chem.upenn.edu/chem/research/faculty.php?browse=V|url-status=dead}}</ref>
